name: Abihu
overview: Abihu, son of Aaron and Elisheba, was called by God to serve in the priesthood alongside his brothers Nadab, Eleazar, and Ithamar (Exodus 6:23; 28:1). He was present with Moses, Aaron, and the elders of Israel at Mount Sinai, signifying his role in the divine covenant (Exodus 24:9). However, Abihu died childless after offering unauthorized fire before the Lord, an act that brought immediate judgment by fire from God (Leviticus 10:1-2; Numbers 3:2). This sobering account underscores the holiness required in approaching God and the serious consequences of disobedience within the sacred priestly office.
